messages:
vivian: Quick a11y flag on the Model row 'Copy' action. Keyboard users don't get a screen-reader confirmation, only a toast visually.
hamid: Can you repro steps?
vivian: 1) Tab to model row, 2) Activate Copy, 3) Visual toast shows, but VoiceOver/NVDA silent. Happens on mac+VO and win+NVDA.
lia: Transient toasts were intentionally non-announced, but copy success is an important semantic action. We should announce it.
tori: Agreed. We can keep the visual toast but also update an aria-live region with a short polite message.
vivian: Minimal approach: add a single role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" node near the app root and write text on success. Example:
```
function announceCopy(text) {
  const node = document.getElementById('a11y-copy-announcer');
  if (!node) return;
  node.textContent = text;
}
```
lia: Add aria-label on the button too: aria-label="Copy model ID" so AT users hear the action name.
hamid: Also noticed the focus ring color on the Copy button in dark theme has very low contrast. Auto-scan shows 1.8:1 for the outline. Screenshot: https://attachments/reports/focus-dark-129.png
tori: Per our focus contrast guideline we target >= 3:1 for focus rings. Propose swapping outline color to #B3D4FF on dark theme which yields ~3.4:1 against bg.
lia: Good. Also debounce announcer updates so rapid repeated clicks don't spam screen readers. A 700ms throttle + clear text after 1s should be fine.
vivian: Unit + e2e plan: unit test for aria-label present, jest-dom check for announcer text mutation; e2e keyboard flow to tab to row, hit Enter, expect announcer text and visible focus ring color. Add dark + light theme runs.
a11y_bot: Scan summary: toast text contrast OK (4.8:1). Focus ring low in dark theme (1.8:1). Missing aria-label on copy button. No aria-live announcer found. Recommend patch and CI e2e.
hamid: I'll open a small PR with: (1) aria-label; (2) announcer node + announceCopy call; (3) focus-ring color tweak in dark theme; (4) unit + e2e test. Assign to @lia for review.
lia: Thanks 44D please also ensure we don't duplicate announcements if toast later adds live region. Check for existing live nodes before writing.
tori: Also update CHANGELOG entry under accessibility.
hamid: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4973 - includes tests and a11y notes.
vivian: Reviewing now. Small nit: use aria-atomic="true" so screen readers always read full message.
lia: Added a small CSS fallback for older browsers.
a11y_bot: CI reminder: include keyboard-run on macOS + win-latest in matrix.
hamid: Will add. Marking this thread resolved once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
